query: I had such a great time trying the new mango sticky rice stall near my hotel yesterday, the coconut sauce was so creamy and not too sweet, I even went back for a second serving before going to the beach. The sunset here was absolutely stunning too, I took so many photos I almost filled up my phone’s camera roll, I can’t wait to show my friends when I get back home. Oh right, I was going to ask you about something with my phone – I’m abroad right now, my roaming is turned off, I have airplane mode on and my network preference settings are all messed up, so I can’t get any mobile data to work at all, can you help me figure out what to do?
